items.question: Can I pay online?
items.answer: No online payment system is connected to this demonstration website.

items.question: How do I confirm a booking?
items.answer: Contact the team via WhatsApp or email and request written confirmation of the route, dates, services and price.

items.question: What is the cancellation policy?
items.answer: Your confirmed written booking terms will govern cancellations. The sample terms page must be finalised before launch.
